content.text:
All 18 playbook rules have been reviewed and submitted. Summary:

**Critical / high deviations**
- **LOL-CAP** — One-sided cap at half of amounts paid, our liability unlimited, no carve-outs; made mutual at 12 months' fees with Excluded Claims.
- **INDEMN** — Only we indemnify; Licensor's IP-infringement liability is affirmatively disclaimed. Added the standard Licensor indemnity.
- **IP** — Silence on our trade/client data and no licence-back for customizations we pay for; added data ownership and a perpetual licence.
- **LICENSE** — Grant limited to our employees only, Affiliates/contractors excluded; added them.
- **T4C** — 36-month lock-in with no convenience exit while Licensor can terminate on any breach; added 30-day right with refund.
- **ASSIGN** — Blanket assignment bar plus automatic termination on our change of control (and a ROFR over a sale of our business); fixed the first two, flagged the ROFR.
- **WARRANTY** — Pure "AS IS"; inserted 90-day conformance warranty and remedy.

**Medium / low deviations**
- **NOSOLICIT** (3-year, one-way, all employees → mutual 12 months, involved personnel), **RENEWAL** (unilateral 7-year renewal → mutual 12 months, capped uplift), **AUDIT** (unlimited frequency → once per 12 months), **INSURANCE** (missing), **TRANSITION** (missing — no data return or exit help).

**Compliant, no redline**
- **GOVLAW** (New York law and courts — preferred), **NONCOMPETE**, **EXCLUSIVITY**, **MFN**, **LD**, **MINCOMMIT** (usage-based fees, no take-or-pay).
